description: Auth layout and auth pages redesign. Remove the <footer> block from layouts/auth.blade.php (user requirement: no footer on auth pages). Add a minimal copyright line inside <main>. Add 'Back to Home' link above the logo on login, register, and forgot-password pages. Apply mobile-first polish (pb-safe, safe viewport centering). These changes affect all auth pages because they share the layout.
